title: Unified finish charter, current-source baseline and ADR parity
decision: Establish one additive source-verifiable finishing backlog, without reinterpreting historical statuses or proposing duplicate missing features.

tasks.title: Pin a real source baseline
tasks.acceptance: Record main SHA, route inventory and exact UI state for the starting candidate.
tasks.verification: Compare source, build and capture manifest.

tasks.title: Map old programme owners
tasks.acceptance: Crosswalk foundational, Flow, gap/final/micro-polish, Lucy and Library decisions.
tasks.verification: Independent ADR link and owner audit.

tasks.title: Classify each candidate gap
tasks.acceptance: Mark already satisfied, refinement, new, verification-only, duplicate or deferred with exact delta.
tasks.verification: Sample current source and related evidence.

tasks.title: Register critical user journeys
tasks.acceptance: Include first-run, listener, expert editor, returning user and errors.

tasks.title: Record preservation invariants
tasks.acceptance: Protect local audio, one player, exact IDs, Undo, consent, eight-lane Studio and FLAC.

tasks.title: Define exclusions
tasks.acceptance: No engine rewrite, cloud upload, accounts, telemetry or native bridge without separate approval.

tasks.title: Prioritise by critical risk
tasks.acceptance: Sequence correctness and comprehension ahead of animation and pixel-only polish.

tasks.title: Approve unified charter
tasks.acceptance: Record named owner, date, rationale and any rejected proposed decisions.

title: Uncoached UX research, comprehension baselines and outcome metrics
decision: Define before/after user evidence, not assumed usability or statistically unsupported product claims.

tasks.title: Recruit explicit user groups
tasks.acceptance: Separate new listeners, experienced editors and assistive-technology users; preserve sample details.

tasks.title: Define uncoached scenarios
tasks.acceptance: First ready mix, exact song, Lucy proposal, seam edit, bridge and export.

tasks.title: Measure baseline success
tasks.acceptance: Record success, errors, time, confusion, confidence and recovery.

tasks.title: Approve threshold before study
tasks.acceptance: Agree proposed >=90% critical-task success separately by cohort, subject to sample caveats.

tasks.title: Compare matched candidate tasks
tasks.acceptance: Use same complexity and music data for baseline/candidate.

tasks.title: Test lifecycle vocabulary
tasks.acceptance: Observe whether users distinguish analysed, mix-ready, proposal, draft, rendering and playing.

tasks.title: Track friction to implementation
tasks.acceptance: Every usability defect gets route, source, severity, reproduction and expected outcome.

tasks.title: Gate research conclusions
tasks.acceptance: Never call automated tests or small qualitative samples statistical superiority.

title: Semantic design tokens, theme contrast and CSS ownership
decision: Make legacy and modern CSS cascade behaviour intentional while protecting existing warm-dark Selecta identity.

tasks.title: Inventory CSS imports
tasks.acceptance: Record import order, selector ownership and high-specificity exceptions.

tasks.title: Assign semantic token ownership
tasks.acceptance: One source for text, surface, focus, selection, statuses, borders and spacing.

tasks.title: Preserve approved visual identity
tasks.acceptance: Retain warm-dark brand and bright accent unless evidence warrants adjustment.

tasks.title: Reconcile overlapping geometry
tasks.acceptance: Measure panel/card/page values before removing or changing overrides.

tasks.title: Verify theme precedence
tasks.acceptance: Manual Light/Dark/System changes and first-paint state remain stable.

tasks.title: Check contrast at final surfaces
tasks.acceptance: Text and non-text boundaries meet applicable WCAG criteria.

tasks.title: Document new CSS rules
tasks.acceptance: Every shared selector and page-local rule has named ownership and an exception policy.

tasks.title: Approve cascade regression proof
tasks.acceptance: No unreviewed style drift under representative themes, sizes or density.
tasks.verification: Paired screenshot and computed CSS acceptance.

title: Typography, honest artwork, spatial rhythm and density
decision: Balance expressive Listen and mix identity with precise readable library, timing and music editing UI.

tasks.title: Define type roles
tasks.acceptance: Specify display, headings, body, metadata, lyrics and numeric values.

tasks.title: Handle difficult song metadata
tasks.acceptance: Long, CJK, RTL, repeated titles and unknown artists remain identifiable.

tasks.title: Standardise spacing relationships
tasks.acceptance: Use defined token rhythm for peer controls, cards, sections and explanatory text.

tasks.title: Bound decorative surfaces
tasks.acceptance: Cards/elevation express actual object grouping rather than nested chrome.

tasks.title: Use truthful imagery
tasks.acceptance: Real authorised art or explicitly decorative motifs, never invented album covers.

tasks.title: Balance scene density
tasks.acceptance: Listen is spacious; Library and Studio preserve expert scan speed.

tasks.title: Protect compact-mode functionality
tasks.acceptance: Density never changes action meaning or makes pointer/touch targets inaccessible.

tasks.title: Verify theme image/text balance
tasks.acceptance: Overlays, contrast and focus survive artwork and both themes.

title: Shared controls, overlays, action hierarchy and feedback
decision: Consolidate already implemented primitives into one predictable interaction and state contract.

tasks.title: Inventory primitive variants
tasks.acceptance: Catalogue buttons, inputs, tabs, menus, tooltips, dialogs, drawers and sheets.

tasks.title: Define primary/secondary action order
tasks.acceptance: One dominant action per decision with discoverable expert alternatives.

tasks.title: Specify long-action feedback
tasks.acceptance: Busy controls resist double-submission without losing keyboard focus.

tasks.title: Arbitrate layered overlays
tasks.acceptance: Player, dialogs, sheets and menus do not obscure focus or trap keyboard.

tasks.title: Validate keyboard semantics
tasks.acceptance: Use appropriate ARIA/APG patterns for tab, menu, combobox and dialog.

tasks.title: Ensure recoverable errors
tasks.acceptance: Failure states explain consequence and next action rather than disappearing toast-only.

tasks.title: Protect scoped Undo
tasks.acceptance: Action history and recovery survive reasonable navigation and notification bursts.

tasks.title: Approve complete component states
tasks.acceptance: Normal, hover, active, focus, selected, disabled, working, error and success are documented.

title: Long-job progress, asynchronous truth and local recovery
decision: Queued analysis, scanning and seam rendering need factual progress and safe recovery across routes.

tasks.title: Define async state vocabulary
tasks.acceptance: Distinguish initial, stale, queued, running, paused, blocked, cancelled, failed and ready.

tasks.title: Reserve skeletons for unknown content
tasks.acceptance: Known long work uses job status or uncertainty; no fake perpetual shimmer.

tasks.title: Explain estimated time honestly
tasks.acceptance: Only locally grounded ranges with clear uncertainty appear.

tasks.title: Protect offline context
tasks.acceptance: Stale useful content is labelled and has reconnect/retry route.

tasks.title: Reconcile lost mutation replies
tasks.acceptance: Preserve idempotency key for retries and report actual result.

tasks.title: Handle cancellations correctly
tasks.acceptance: Cancelled, superseded and failed work cannot be shown as successful.

tasks.title: Keep live feedback calm
tasks.acceptance: Foreground errors take precedence over background completion noise.

tasks.title: Preserve layout and focus
tasks.acceptance: Changing asynchronous content does not jump controls or navigation unexpectedly.

title: Navigation, first-run readiness and returning-work continuity
decision: Build on the existing five-intent shell and first-run flow without breaking deep links or silently changing music.

tasks.title: Validate five destination intents
tasks.acceptance: Listen, Make a Mix, My Mixes, Library and Workspace remain understandable.

tasks.title: Preserve URL meaning
tasks.acceptance: Back, forward, aliases and refresh retain exact draft/conversation/tab target.

tasks.title: Explain music-folder entry
tasks.acceptance: Local path, access errors and scan consequences are clear without promising unsupported folder pickers.

tasks.title: Separate readiness stages
tasks.acceptance: Imported, analysed and mix-ready are distinct and actionable.

tasks.title: Protect first playback
tasks.acceptance: Only genuinely eligible sets can be offered as ready; no unrequested autoplay.

tasks.title: Restore returning work
tasks.acceptance: Recent drafts and route context return without replacing music.

tasks.title: Remove shell occlusion
tasks.acceptance: Rail, mobile bottom bar, context header and mini-player leave actions usable.

tasks.title: Keep focus navigation obvious
tasks.acceptance: Keyboard palette, landmarks and active destination remain coherent.

title: Persistent player, system media controls and audio focus
decision: Polish fixed player and preview handoffs without altering single audio-owner guarantees.

tasks.title: Keep one authoritative audio owner
tasks.acceptance: Full/mini transport and all previews never overlap improperly.

tasks.title: Align mini/full transport state
tasks.acceptance: Song, phase, time and loading/seam labels are identical across screens.

tasks.title: Bound seek semantics
tasks.acceptance: Missing duration, seam boundary and unavailable audio never yield invalid time or false success.

tasks.title: Protect preview interruptions
tasks.acceptance: Studio/Requests/Discover audition does not inadvertently resume or pause user music.

tasks.title: Make navigation audio-inert
tasks.acceptance: Route, overlay and theme changes do not replace, start or pause playback.

tasks.title: Verify system media session
tasks.acceptance: OS/browser transport controls reflect actual player state.

tasks.title: Keep fixed chrome reachable
tasks.acceptance: Transport remains functional with safe-area, mobile keyboard and 400% zoom.

tasks.title: Explain output interruptions
tasks.acceptance: Mute, lost device and unavailable seam have recoverable visible status.

title: Listen hierarchy, lyrics integrity, seek and transitions
decision: Make current music and real temporal cues visually dominant without losing the many existing options.

tasks.title: Prioritise now-playing
tasks.acceptance: Identity, transport, progress and coming handoff appear before optional configuration.

tasks.title: Label timed lyrics honestly
tasks.acceptance: Approximate word timing is not presented as sung-word ground truth.

tasks.title: Fit long title variations
tasks.acceptance: Long/RTL/CJK song metadata and repeated titles remain readable at zoom.

tasks.title: Synchronise handoff information
tasks.acceptance: Countdown and transition scene follow actual playback clock and seam.

tasks.title: Provide accessible seeking
tasks.acceptance: Overview strip enables keyboard/pointer seeking with bounded status.

tasks.title: Clarify next-song steering
tasks.acceptance: Next-up actions do not promise ready audio where absent.

tasks.title: Reduce optional panel competition
tasks.acceptance: Lyrics, spectrum settings and reasons use a secondary hierarchy.

tasks.title: Test passive and active listening
tasks.acceptance: No configuration is required to enjoy music; essential controls remain available.

title: Existing fifteen visualisers, Stage and sensory-safe motion
decision: Curate existing visualisers and motion preferences rather than rebuilding modes or faking music visuals.

tasks.title: Preserve all fifteen options
tasks.acceptance: No visualiser is accidentally removed; choices remain stable.

tasks.title: Use live audio bins only
tasks.acceptance: Pause/silence produce truthful visual stillness.

tasks.title: Make visualiser choice accessible
tasks.acceptance: Recommended presentation does not hide full selector.

tasks.title: Sync effects to real transitions
tasks.acceptance: Visual handoffs correspond to actual audio clock not animation loop.

tasks.title: Respect reduced motion first
tasks.acceptance: OS preference overrides Subtle/Expressive; Still mode is consistently calm.

tasks.title: Review sensory safety
tasks.acceptance: Flashing, brightness and lyric distraction have conservative defaults.

tasks.title: Keep Stage usable
tasks.acceptance: Fullscreen entry/exit/escape/focus work across themes and sizes.

tasks.title: Measure frame and energy costs
tasks.acceptance: Active and hidden-tab visualisation stay within agreed named-device budget.

title: Make a Mix quick paths, moods, shaping and Lucy handoff
decision: LX-0353/0354 own Make a Mix presentation; UF owns the combined journey and guards.

tasks.title: Delegate detailed design to LX
tasks.acceptance: Use existing LX-0353/0354 contracts and classify only integration gaps.

tasks.title: Make Quick Play predictable
tasks.acceptance: Communicate actual readiness and next step without requiring DJ knowledge.

tasks.title: Guard active mix replacement
tasks.acceptance: Show consequence and existing Undo when changing currently audible music.

tasks.title: Use genuine mood facts
tasks.acceptance: Mood cards compare source-backed vibe, duration and eligible song counts.

tasks.title: Keep advanced controls optional
tasks.acceptance: Energy, stems and target can be shaped without blocking basic listen.

tasks.title: Preserve Lucy handoff scope
tasks.acceptance: Mood/selected prompt is prefilled exactly and never auto-sent.

tasks.title: Handle insufficient ready songs
tasks.acceptance: Offer scan/analysis path rather than impossible mix action.

tasks.title: Check responsive card actions
tasks.acceptance: Mobile layouts retain comparable cards and safe button targets.

title: Library integration, LX ownership and exact-recording safety
decision: LX-0340–0352 remain primary Library design owners; UF only closes cross-app data, scope and evidence gaps.

tasks.title: Crosswalk LX Library work
tasks.acceptance: Avoid restating LX-0340–0352 as unimplemented functionality.

tasks.title: Protect recording ID navigation
tasks.acceptance: Playback and mix actions use stable exact ID, not row position or title.

tasks.title: Preserve search URL and Back
tasks.acceptance: Filter, sort and selected detail survive history/reload as intended.

tasks.title: Reconcile readiness counts
tasks.acceptance: Library, Make a Mix and Workspace use canonical source status.

tasks.title: Protect loaded batch selection
tasks.acceptance: Large filtered libraries never mutate outside confirmed selected IDs.

tasks.title: Measure collection scale
tasks.acceptance: Search, scrolling and batch interaction budgets tested on 20k fixture.

tasks.title: Ensure inspector and player parity
tasks.acceptance: Details overlay does not lose focus or obscure player at zoom.

tasks.title: Record real integration deltas
tasks.acceptance: Only changes not owned by LX get a UF implementation task; update statuses independently.
